name: Barbara Schaffner
detail: Postulate-style motion 24.3761 asks the Federal Council to examine models of a federal wealth tax; a request to study, not a call for the tax.

name: Juso Schweiz (initiative "For a future", 50% inheritance tax above CHF 50 million)
detail: Inheritance and gift tax, not a tax on the stock of wealth. Its supporters are not recorded on that evidence.

name: Karin Stüber
detail: Swiss heir and board chair quoted by SRF (23 Oct 2026) as "not fundamentally against a wealth tax" but saying 2 percent is too much; not a call for one.
